section_path: **Condition Report (CR) - Elevated Vibration on AFW Pump P-101A** > **1. Condition Description**
text: During routine surveillance, AFW Pump P-101A exhibited elevated vibration after start. Vibration channel VB-101A peaked at 6.2 mils (alarm setpoint 5.0 mils) with stable flow at 465 gpm and discharge pressure at 1175 psig. No bearing temperature alarms were observed.
raw_text: During routine surveillance, AFW Pump P-101A exhibited elevated vibration after start. Vibration channel VB-101A peaked at 6.2 mils (alarm setpoint 5.0 mils) with stable flow at 465 gpm and discharge pressure at 1175 psig. No bearing temperature alarms were observed.

section_path: **Condition Report (CR) - Elevated Vibration on AFW Pump P-101A** > **2. Immediate Actions**
text: Operator stopped P-101A within 2 minutes of alarm. Control Room notified. Train A declared inoperable pending evaluation. Condition entered into the corrective action program.
raw_text: Operator stopped P-101A within 2 minutes of alarm. Control Room notified. Train A declared inoperable pending evaluation. Condition entered into the corrective action program.

section_path: **Condition Report (CR) - Elevated Vibration on AFW Pump P-101A** > **4. Apparent Cause (if known)**
text: Unknown at initiation. Potential contributors include reduced suction pressure margin and coupling misalignment.
